# Preliminary results v2 (auto-generated by src/event_study.py)

Events: 60 curated (48 actions, 12 threats), day 0 = public_date; events within 10 days of each other in a group are merged.
Abnormal transits = residual of log1p(transits) on DOW+month+year FE + ERA5 max wave height (lags 0-2) + IBTrACS TC within 300 km (lags 0-3) + max TC wind within 500 km; fitted on days >14 d from any event. 7-day smoothed.
Window (-14, 21), baseline (-28, -8), effect = mean over days (0, 14). Placebo: 2000 draws of the mean path over random non-event dates.
